text: All verdict labels and party names are rendered by HTML, never baked into the texture. Round metadata and captions sit outside the image; the large ruling label uses each artwork's safe parchment area at its original 3:1 aspect ratio.
history: Presentation uses saved verdict responsibility fields; older plain-text decisions use only explicit wording in the first ruling paragraph, otherwise retain a neutral archive label. Full verdict and evidence stay unchanged.
model: Same createCatModel renderer, licensed Mage Cat assets and current appearance as home; procedural 3D gavel and bench are court-only scene decoration.
testing: Read-only historical preview inspected at 320 and 390 viewport widths. Full flow, lifecycle and deployment checks await combined acceptance. Built-in imagegen was used for the artwork; no new court case or real OpenAI verdict inference was submitted for this change.
